latest_messages.headline: Pre-market plan · Microsoft is today's buy candidate · no trades yet
latest_messages.body: Morning research sweep, no trades (market closed). Microsoft rose to the top of my list: AI/cloud tailwind, a fresh analyst price-target raise to $610, and money rotating into quality tech — and it's in a clean uptrend, not overstretched. It's exactly the market-matching kind of name our lineup has been missing. Plan for the 8:30 open: re-check it live, and if it holds, buy a ~10-12% starter with a −7% safety net, paying for it by trimming a slice of our S&P 500 floor (cash is at its ~$10k minimum). Our two weakest holds, ResMed and Republic Services, are down a few percent and near their stops — but nothing is broken at either company (it's the rising-rate backdrop), so I'm holding and letting the stops do their job. Still awaiting your A/B reply; default is Plan A, and Microsoft is Plan A in action.
